page.layout: One page of text, single column, full width. Running head at top. Last word "plane" is hyphenated at line end and completed with a catchword-like mark "ne" at lower right, treated as catchword.

main_text.p: Thaletem, Anaximandrum, cæterósque prifcorum Coryphæos philosophantium, cœli fiderúmque speculationi tantum intentos, nihílque ne sibi quidem sæpenumero, ne dum aliis aut Reipublicæ prodesse videret: relicta hac inani contemplatione, quâ peritiores non meliores indies fieri poterant homines, ad Philosophiam Practicam, quæ ad bene honesteque vivendum instruit, hortari cunctos serió cœpit: Unde Philosophiam è cœlo primus devocasse dictus erat. Socratis innixus vestigiis Plato, quæ moralem spectant Philosophiam passim ferè scriptis suis infspergit tanta famæ nominisque celebritate sui, ut non Athenis modo, sed & in tota Græcia, nec in Græcia tantum, sed in remotissimis orbis terrarū regionibus Philosophus audiret plane

page.notes: Running head "EPISTOLA" is letterspaced capitals. Text is set in long-s style; the long s has been rendered as plain s. The word "plane" is split across the line end and completed as "ne" at the foot right. Some words (e.g. "relicta", "contemplatione") carry circumflex marks as printed. No page number is printed. Some ink show-through is present and omitted.
